name: Presidency College, Chennai
summary: Presidency College, established in 1840, is a government autonomous college affiliated to the University of Madras. Its undergraduate courses run in a morning shift (8 am–1 pm) and an afternoon shift (1–5 pm), many in both Tamil and English medium, with language programmes in Hindi, Malayalam and Urdu and B.Com and BCA sections reserved for hearing-impaired students. Fees are the nominal government-college rates.

applicationPlatform.value: TNGASA — the common online portal for Tamil Nadu's 181 government arts and science colleges

applicationFee.value: ₹50 (₹2 for SC/SCA/ST applicants), paid on TNGASA

domesticTuition.notes: Fee schedule on the college's fee page: ₹1,295 for B.A./B.Com., ₹1,315 for B.Sc. (incl. ₹250 PTA). The page doesn't state whether this is per year or per admission.

scholarships.name: Fee remission for backward-class students
scholarships.eligibility: Poor students belonging to backward classes may be granted full fee remission on the same terms as the half-fee concession.
